body:
Someone's unconventional choice starts building on itself.

Each honest refusal they make shows the direction more clearly, and the people who matter adjust faster than anyone predicted.

With Lilith trine the North Node, people put an appetite with years of pressure behind it to work in the direction that can finally employ it.

Even the people on the familiar route lend support instead of drag.

The progress may look accidental, but people watching closely can hear appetite and direction finally pulling the same load.
